name: L’Ayalga
summary: Devpost project page for an AI co-host that turns a stay invitation into a coordinated, inspectable visit for shared households.
description: A Devpost hackathon entry (Agents for Humans) describing an AI co-host for shared homes: a host turns an informal invitation into a private guest journey, guests search feasible dates and choose exact rooms, and the agent handles proactive reconfirmation and escalation while capacity, occupancy and children/pets policy stay in deterministic code. Built with the Strands Agents TypeScript SDK on Amazon Bedrock (Claude Sonnet 4.6) with AgentCore Runtime and Memory, Next.js and TypeScript, and Supabase PostgreSQL.
contains: AI co-host that coordinates shared-home visits from invitation to follow-up
guests search feasible dates and choose exact rooms; capacity, occupancy and pet rules run in deterministic code
AgentCore Memory ranks valid rooms by recalled preferences
proactive reconfirmation by verified email, with exceptions escalated to hosts
explicit human confirmation required for cancellations and withdrawal
Strands Agents TypeScript SDK, Amazon Bedrock with Claude Sonnet 4.6, AgentCore Runtime and Memory, CloudWatch
Next.js and TypeScript host and guest journeys; Supabase PostgreSQL authoritative for bookings and policy
